items.title: Sony Music、Warner 入稟控告 Anthropic 盜版訓練 Claude
items.title_en: Sony Music and Warner Sue Anthropic Over Alleged Piracy Used to Train Claude
items.summary: Sony Music Publishing 同 Warner Chappell 聯合入稟，指 Anthropic 以盜版方式取得版權音樂訓練 Claude。法院早前裁定 AI 訓練使用版權作品本身合法，今次係針對「盜竊取得」行為，Anthropic 表示積極抗辯。
items.summary_en: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell filed suit against Anthropic, alleging it used pirated routes to acquire copyrighted songs for Claude training. A prior court ruling permits using copyrighted works for AI training but found pirating them illegal — this case targets the acquisition method. Anthropic said it will mount a vigorous defense.
items.why: Agency 日日用 Claude 做創意，呢案判決可影響 AI 工具授權成本，要跟進。
items.why_en: Agencies relying on Claude for creative work should monitor this — a ruling could reshape AI tool licensing costs and compliance obligations.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 智譜 GLM-5.3-Flash 開源，評分達 Claude Opus 水準
items.title_en: Zhipu Open-Sources GLM-5.3-Flash, Matching Claude Opus 4.8 on AI Benchmarks
items.summary: 智譜正式開源 GLM-5.3-Flash（320B，18B 激活），原生多模態，Artificial Analysis 評分同 Claude Opus 4.8 持平，全程靠商湯國產算力訓練，上線前以匿名身份累計處理 62 萬億 Token。
items.summary_en: Zhipu released GLM-5.3-Flash as open source — a 320B native multimodal model scoring on par with Claude Opus 4.8 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. The model was trained entirely on SenseTime's domestic chips and processed 62 trillion tokens in anonymous pre-launch testing.
items.why: 又多一個頂尖中文開源模型，中國區部署可考慮，減少海外 API 依賴風險。
items.why_en: A strong open-source option for agencies with mainland China operations — top-tier performance on domestic infrastructure reduces overseas API dependency.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 北歐 TechBBQ：誰能真正掌控 AI？歐洲爆發主權焦慮
items.title_en: TechBBQ 2026: Who Controls AI? Europe's Sovereignty Anxiety Peaks
items.summary: 北歐最大科技會議 TechBBQ 今年焦點係 AI 主權，演講者警告歐洲過度依賴美中 AI 基建，Anthropic Fable 突然停止歐洲服務成導火索，Signal 主席批評 AI 演變為大型數據收集裝置。
items.summary_en: At TechBBQ in Copenhagen, investors and founders debated AI sovereignty after Anthropic's Fable and Mythos models went unavailable outside the US. Signal's Meredith Whittaker warned AI is becoming a data-collection apparatus, and speakers cautioned against dependence on foreign AI infrastructure.
items.why: AI 供應商可以隨時停服，單一外國平台風險高，備用方案要提前準備。
items.why_en: Vendor lock-in is a real business risk — agencies and clients should diversify AI tool providers and plan for service disruptions.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Nvidia 優勢伸延 GPU 以外：掌控整個 AI 數據中心系統層
items.title_en: Nvidia's Edge Expands Beyond GPUs to Full AI Data Center Infrastructure
items.summary: Nvidia 新一代 Vera Rubin 架構將競爭優勢從 GPU 延伸至整個數據中心系統層，涵蓋專用 CPU、推理加速器同高速網絡設備，應對 gigawatt 級 AI 部署規模對數據流量調度嘅新需求。
items.summary_en: Nvidia's new Vera Rubin architecture extends its competitive moat beyond GPUs to include specialized CPUs, inference accelerators, and data center networking gear. As AI deployments scale to gigawatt levels, routing data traffic efficiently becomes as critical as raw compute.
items.why: AI 算力格局整合中，長遠影響 AI 服務定價，做 AI 投資 ROI 分析時值得了解。
items.why_en: As AI infrastructure consolidates, compute costs and service pricing will shift — factor this into client AI investment ROI analysis.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenClaw 熱潮退幕：AI Agent 框架已被主流產品吸收
items.title_en: OpenClaw Fades as AI Agent Frameworks Get Absorbed Into Mainstream Platforms
items.summary: 曾達 38 萬 GitHub Star 嘅開源 AI Agent OpenClaw 淡出，並非失敗而係被主流吸納——騰訊百度網易推出衍生「龍蝦」產品，Claude Code 同 Codex 建立原生 Agent 框架，創辦人已加入 OpenAI 研究多 Agent 軟件工廠流水線。
items.summary_en: OpenClaw, once a 380K-star open-source AI Agent, faded not by failing but by absorption into mainstream tools. Tencent, Baidu, and NetEase launched derivative products; Claude Code and Codex built native agent frameworks. Its founder joined OpenAI to explore multi-agent software factory pipelines.
items.why: AI Agent 進入成熟期，直接用 Claude Code 或平台原生 Agent 出稿，唔使再自建框架。
items.why_en: AI agents have matured — use native agents in Claude Code and platform tools instead of building custom frameworks from scratch.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: The Trade Desk Kokai 整合 Agentic AI，程式化廣告邁向自主模式
items.title_en: The Trade Desk Upgrades Kokai with Agentic AI for Autonomous Programmatic Buying
items.summary: The Trade Desk 大幅升級 Kokai 程式化廣告平台，整合 Agentic AI 功能並退役舊版手動介面，AI 自主完成廣告優化目標，唔再需要人手逐一設定 targeting 參數。
items.summary_en: The Trade Desk overhauled its Kokai programmatic platform with agentic AI, retiring the legacy manual interface. The system now autonomously optimizes toward campaign goals, reducing the need for hands-on parameter management.
items.why: 程式化落廣告轉向 AI 自主模式，agency 要學識 brief AI 目標，唔係手動設定參數。
items.why_en: Programmatic buying is shifting from manual parameter-setting to goal-briefing AI agents — agencies need to evolve from bid management to AI campaign direction.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 法官質疑 Google AI 概覽「對出版商不公平」，Spam 更新打擊 AI 農場
items.title_en: Judge Calls Google AI Overviews 'Really Unfair' as Spam Update Targets AI Content Farms
items.summary: 美國聯邦法官批評 Google 把出版商內容直接餵 AI Overviews 係「不公平」，可能涉及壟斷；同期 Google Spam Update 打擊 AI 生成內容農場，新數據顯示 AI 推薦品牌只有 31% 機率帶來實際點擊。
items.summary_en: A U.S. federal judge called Google's use of publisher content for AI Overviews 'really unfair,' raising antitrust concerns. Google's August Spam Update simultaneously targeted AI content farms. New data shows AI-recommended brands only drive direct clicks 31% of the time.
items.why: AI 搜尋曝光唔等於流量，要向客戶重新解釋 AI SEO 嘅真實 ROI，唔係「被提及就夠」。
items.why_en: AI visibility doesn't equal traffic — being cited in AI answers only drives clicks 31% of the time. Reframe SEO ROI conversations with clients accordingly.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: X Grok Bot 推免費 API 積分，連帳號可即分析品牌輿情
items.title_en: X Offers Free API Credits for Grok Bot Users to Analyze Brand Mentions
items.summary: X 向 Grok Bot 付費用戶提供免費 API 積分，連接帳號後可分析 timeline、品牌提及同平台熱點趨勢，同時推動用戶自建品牌專屬 Bot 同 Agent。
items.summary_en: X is offering complimentary API credits to paid Grok Bot users to analyze timelines, brand mentions, and platform trends by connecting their X accounts. The move also encourages marketers to build brand-specific bots and agents.
items.why: 零成本試用 AI 分析 X 平台客戶討論，品牌監測同競品研究唔使另外付 API 費。
items.why_en: Analyze X brand conversations and competitor activity at no extra API cost — a quick win for social listening without additional budget.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Threads 測試 Gem 獎勵制度，高互動內容或有現金獎賞
items.title_en: Threads Tests Gem Awards for High-Engagement Posts, Potentially Including Cash Rewards
items.summary: Threads 測試虛擬 Gem 獎勵制度，高互動貼文可獲頒 Gem，部分版本顯示設有現金成分，與 X 創作者獎勵計劃相似，反映 Meta 正深化 Threads 創作者生態建設。
items.summary_en: Threads is testing a Gem award system for high-engagement posts, with some code references suggesting a monetary component similar to X's creator rewards. The test signals Meta's deepening investment in Threads as a competitive content platform.
items.why: Threads 建立創作者激勵，宜盡早養成高互動內容習慣，搶演算法紅利期。
items.why_en: Build strong Threads engagement habits now before the reward system matures — early movers capture more algorithmic lift.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 英特爾 Arc Pro B70 本地 AIGC 影片製作全流程亮相廣州
items.title_en: Intel Arc Pro B70 Powers Complete Local AIGC Video Pipeline at Guangzhou Workshop
items.summary: 英特爾廣州工作坊展示 Arc Pro B70（32GB 顯存，367 TOPS）本地 AI 影片製作全流程，從劇本到 AI 圖像、影片生成、配音到成片，720P 生成放大至 1080P-2K，製作步驟由 20+ 壓縮至 3 個核心節點。
items.summary_en: Intel's Arc Pro B70 GPU (32GB VRAM, 367 TOPS) demonstrated a complete local AIGC video pipeline in Guangzhou — from scripting and AI image generation to video production and dubbing, compressing 20+ production steps to just 3 core nodes, outputting 720P upscaled to 1080P-2K.
items.why: 國內 AIGC 影片可本地化生產，唔受海外 API 斷線影響，出稿速度同成本控制均改善。
items.why_en: Local AI video pipelines in China eliminate overseas API dependency for content production — faster turnarounds and better cost control for agencies with mainland operations.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 商湯大裝置協助 HiDream 影片生成業務遷移至國產芯片
items.title_en: SenseTime Helps HiDream Migrate AI Video Generation to Domestic Chips with 93% Speedup
items.summary: 商湯大裝置同 HiDream.ai 合作，以 LightX2V 多卡並行在國產芯片上實現影片生成 93% 加速，解決多卡面部表情不一致問題，統一硬件抽象層支持 10+ 種異構芯片零成本遷移。
items.summary_en: SenseTime's Large Installation partnered with HiDream.ai to migrate video generation to domestic chips, achieving a 93% speedup via LightX2V multi-card parallelism and solving facial inconsistency across cards. A unified hardware abstraction layer enables zero-cost migration across 10+ heterogeneous chip types.
items.why: 中國 AI 影片生成基建加速去美化，供應商選擇同服務穩定性會有變動，注意合作方策略。
items.why_en: China's AI video infrastructure is rapidly decoupling from US hardware — expect pricing and availability shifts for AI video services in the mainland market.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 阿里 Qoder 桌面版：語音對話即可構建完整軟件，覆蓋 6 億用戶
items.title_en: Alibaba Qoder Desktop: Build Complete Software by Voice, No Code Required
items.summary: 阿里 Qoder 桌面版加入語音 AI 夥伴，非開發者可用對話完整構建軟件，演示包括全程對話建立咖啡館管理系統，覆蓋 6 億用戶，支持 40+ 連接器同 70+ 插件。
items.summary_en: Alibaba's Qoder desktop app introduces a voice-interactive AI companion letting non-developers build complete software through natural conversation. Live demos showed building a café management system entirely by voice. The platform serves 600M users and 100,000 enterprise clients, with 40+ connectors and 70+ plugins.
items.why: Agency 唔需要碼農都可以快速建立客戶 demo 或行銷工具，壓縮 pitch 前置時間。
items.why_en: Non-technical agency teams can now prototype client tools and demos through voice alone, cutting pitch prep time without developer overhead.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 高德 ABot-Recon：12 幀影片重建萬幀 3D 場景，消費級顯卡可跑
items.title_en: AutoNavi ABot-Recon: Reconstruct 10,000-Frame 3D Scenes From Just 12 Frames on Consumer GPUs
items.summary: 高德地圖發布開源 ABot-Recon，僅需 12 幀連續影像即可重建跨越萬幀嘅 3D 場景，平均軌跡誤差較現有方法低 40%，可喺 GTX 1080 Ti 消費級顯卡運行，代碼同模型已上 GitHub 同 ModelScope。
items.summary_en: AutoNavi (Alibaba Maps) released open-source ABot-Recon, reconstructing thousands of 3D scene frames from just 12 input frames with 40% lower trajectory error than leading methods. It runs on a consumer GTX 1080 Ti, with code and model weights available on GitHub and ModelScope.
items.why: 廣告製作中街景同地標 3D 化成本大降，適用於製作沉浸式廣告或 AR 行銷內容。
items.why_en: Low-cost 3D reconstruction from video clips opens new possibilities for immersive ad content and AR marketing experiences without expensive 3D scanning.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: PUMA 同曼城首件球迷 AI 設計波衫上陣，18 萬份提交中脫穎而出
items.title_en: PUMA and Man City Debut First Fan-Designed AI Kit on the Pitch, Selected From 180,000 Submissions
items.summary: Manchester City 同 PUMA 公布首件由球迷用 AI 工具設計、實際上陣嘅球衣，共收 18 萬份提交、170 萬次球迷評分，最終由 AI 生成設計脫穎而出實際著用，係 AI 大規模 co-creation 行銷嘅里程碑。
items.summary_en: Manchester City and PUMA debuted the first fan-designed AI-generated kit worn on the pitch, selected from 180,000 submissions and 1.7 million fan ratings via PUMA's generative AI design tool. The campaign transformed passive fans into active brand co-creators at massive scale.
items.why: AI 大規模 co-creation 行銷真係得，可直接用嚟 pitch 品牌客戶，係有實績嘅案例。
items.why_en: Proof that AI co-creation at massive scale works as a marketing mechanic — a ready-made case study for pitching participatory AI campaign models to brand clients.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 研究：86% Gen Z 想自主探索品味，73% 分唔清真實偏好同演算法推介
items.title_en: Study: 86% of Gen Z Want to Discover Their Own Tastes — 73% Can't Tell Real Preferences From Algorithm
items.summary: Pinterest 委託調查新加坡 1,009 名 18-29 歲用戶，86% 想不受外界影響自主探索品味，73% 難以分辨真實偏好同演算法暗示，「存起慢慢看」行為令靈感驅動型搜尋同比升 190%。
items.summary_en: A Pinterest-commissioned survey of 1,009 Singapore residents aged 18–29 found 86% want to explore tastes without outside influence, while 73% struggle to distinguish genuine preferences from algorithmic suggestions. A 190% surge in inspiration-led searches signals growing demand for self-directed discovery.
items.why: Gen Z 嫌 targeting 太精準，行銷策略要留空間「自己發現」，強行推送會反效果。
items.why_en: Over-personalization alienates Gen Z — leave room for self-discovery in campaign targeting, or risk damaging brand perception with audiences who sense the algorithm.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Caterpillar 五年投 1 億美元為 11.8 萬員工做 AI 培訓
items.title_en: Caterpillar Commits $100M Over 5 Years to Train 118,000 Employees on AI
items.summary: Caterpillar 宣布五年投入 1 億美元為 11.8 萬名全球員工進行 AI 培訓，CTO 強調最難唔係技術而係「將 AI 整合進現有工作流程」，以數十年自主化礦山經驗加速企業 AI 落地。
items.summary_en: Caterpillar announced a $100M, five-year commitment to AI training for its 118,000 global employees. The CTO emphasized that technology is the easy part — the real challenge is integrating AI into existing workflows. The company is drawing on decades of autonomous mining experience to guide this transition.
items.why: 大型企業 AI 培訓投資呢個規模係行業訊號，pitch 時可說：「AI 唔係工具採購，係 transformation 服務」。
items.why_en: Enterprise AI training at this scale signals a market shift — reframe agency pitches around workflow transformation services, not just tool procurement.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 前 a16z 生物科技主管創 AI-native VC，每年只押 5 個注
items.title_en: Former a16z Biotech Chief Launches AI-Native VC, Making Just 5 Concentrated Bets Per Year
items.summary: 前 a16z 40 億生物科技主管 Vijay Pande 創立 VZVC，每年只做約 5 個集中投資，以 AI Agent 取代人類助理，指 AI 令生物學從「探索」轉型為「工程化」，唯一限制係「數據根本不存在時 AI 亦無計可施」。
items.summary_en: Former a16z biotech chief Vijay Pande launched VZVC, making roughly five concentrated investments per year using AI agents in place of human associates. He argues biology is shifting from discovery to engineering via AI, but notes AI cannot solve problems where foundational data simply doesn't exist.
items.why: VC 層面已用 AI Agent 取代人手分析師，agency 要說清楚自己哪個部分係 AI 取代不了嘅。
items.why_en: If VC firms are replacing analysts with AI agents, agencies must articulate what human judgment they bring that AI can't replicate — or compete on the same cost curve.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Pinterest 宣布 9 月 17 日廣告主峰會，Q4 工具更新即將出爐
items.title_en: Pinterest Sets 'Pinterest Presents' Advertiser Summit for September 17 — Q4 Updates Incoming
items.summary: Pinterest 宣布 9 月 17 日舉辦年度「Pinterest Presents」虛擬廣告主峰會，承諾公布新功能同最佳實踐，平台月活 6.4 億（按年升 11%），重點係 AI 購物同 discovery 工具更新。
items.summary_en: Pinterest announced its annual 'Pinterest Presents' virtual advertiser summit for September 17, 2026, with new product announcements and best practices. The platform has 640 million monthly active users (up 11% YoY), with AI-powered shopping and discovery tools in focus.
items.why: 9月17日前備好 Q4 廣告策略問題，特別係 Pinterest AI 購物工具，上下漏斗都有用。
items.why_en: Prepare Q4 campaign questions before September 17 — Pinterest's AI shopping and discovery updates could open new full-funnel opportunities in the peak season.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法

items.title: 本地部署 LLM 效果差過官方版？734 個依賴包，每個都可能係問題
items.title_en: Why Local LLM Deployments Underperform Hosted Versions: 734 Dependencies, Any One Can Break It
items.summary: 以 Qwen3-27B 為例，本地 LLM 差過官方嘅三大原因：注意力後端選擇、KV 快取精度、張量並行設定，vLLM 容器帶 734 個依賴包，任何一個配置錯可令工具調用全部失效。
items.summary_en: A Qwen3-27B case study reveals three root causes of local LLMs underperforming hosted versions: attention backend selection, KV cache quantization precision, and tensor parallelism settings. A single vLLM container carries 734 dependency packages — any misconfiguration can silently break tool-calling entirely.
items.why: IT 同技術團隊部署私有 AI 前必睇，下載模型後配置錯誤會令整個工作流靜靜失效。
items.why_en: Before deploying a private LLM, review these three parameters — configuration errors silently break AI workflows without obvious errors until you debug them.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法

items.title: 調查揭 Waymo/Zoox 測試司機逾 24 宗受傷：AI 透明度嘅公關警示
items.title_en: Investigation: 24+ Waymo and Zoox Test Drivers Injured — A Transparency Warning for AI Deployments
items.summary: 調查揭示 Waymo 同 Zoox 測試司機 2024-25 年有逾 24 宗 OSHA 受傷記錄，因自動緊急制動導致。Waymo 同時宣布部署 Vision Language Model 同自家芯片升級，自動卡車公司 Gatik 宣布 2 億美元融資。
items.summary_en: An investigation found 24+ injuries among Waymo and Zoox test drivers recorded with OSHA in 2024–25, caused by sudden autonomous braking. Waymo also announced new VLM-based systems and custom silicon upgrades. Autonomous trucking startup Gatik simultaneously announced $200M in new funding.
items.why: AI 商業化帶嚟隱藏代價，部署 AI 自動化時要提前建立透明度溝通機制，唔好等事發才補救。
items.why_en: Real-world AI deployments create accountability gaps. Establish AI transparency communication protocols before incidents occur — reactive damage control is far more costly.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
